summary: Install-time host identifier exfiltration to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: pandafortunerush@1.0.0 declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that issue plain-HTTP GET requests to http://38.242.235.206/depconf/pandafortunerush/{preinstall,postinstall}, carrying the installer's username (process.env.USER / USERNAME), OS hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as query parameters. The requests fire automatically on `npm install` with no caller consent. The package self-describes as a defensive dependency-confusion placeholder for an internal project name, but ships no functional code — its only runtime effect is the install-time beacon of installer identity to an unrelated bare-IP destination. The destination is not a registry, publisher-matched host, or documented telemetry endpoint; sending installer host identifiers to it on install discloses internal hostnames, usernames, and build-path layout useful for targeting follow-on attacks against the installing organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
